outcome: noradrenaline (NA) levels in fetal cord blood
adrenaline (A) levels in fetal cord blood
cortisol levels in fetal cord blood
cohort: The study included 65 singleton pregnancies, comprising 42 fetuses with intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) and 23 control fetuses.
finding: IUGR fetuses demonstrated adrenal sparing, characterized by a significantly higher adrenal/abdominal circumference (AD/AC) ratio and elevated cord noradrenaline and adrenaline levels compared to controls.
cross-section timing: Ultrasound measurements were taken between 25 and 37 weeks of gestation, and cord blood was collected at the time of delivery.
gest_age: Between 25 and 37 weeks of gestation for ultrasound measurements.
